intelligence.human_view: Two lessons in one dictation, and they are the same lesson at two depths. On the surface: the dial must be alive — white text, never gray; profiles separated and distinct, not one gray block; the rainbow flow in the richest colors, repeating like the 108 diamonds, white-green-blue-purple, again and again. Gray is the color of a system that does not care; the dial is the front door of a world, and a front door is never gray. Underneath: the jump must be real. A button that says "Jump back in as Shawn" and lands on the shared Hub is a lie told in friendly colors — the code even wrote the lie down in a comment, calling the Hub "the citizen's world" when the Hub is a shared component. The fix is not a better label; it is a real page, generated for that citizen's identity, world, and data. The open question — "maybe there's another way, with maybe emojis" — is the right shape for a question the maker judges by eye: he knows it could be better, he does not know how, and he does not pretend to. And the sequencing matters as much as the design: one change at a time on the shared base file, or the dial fix and the feeds fix collide in the same bytes.
intelligence.simple_view: The front door of your world should be bright and beautiful — white letters, rainbow colors, every person standing out clearly, alive and happy! And when you tap your name to jump back in, it must take you to YOUR very own page — your real world, made just for you — not to some boring shared room that isn't yours at all!
intelligence.grandma_view: The front door, love — it should be bright and welcoming, white letters you can read, rainbow colors, every person clear and distinct, never all mushed together in gray. And when you tap your name, it must take you home — to YOUR page, your world, made for you — never to some shared hallway that belongs to everyone and no one.
intelligence.naya_view: I make the entry dial alive. Gray becomes white — he hates gray, and every gray line goes white. Profiles stand apart, readable, distinct, active, alive — active intelligence. The rainbow flow runs in the richest colors, repeating like the 108 diamonds: new user white, also on this device green, jump back in blue, jump back in as a name purple — and the pattern repeats as the profiles list. And every Jump back in lands on the citizen's REAL Personal page, generated for their identity, their world, their data — never the Hub, never a boxed stub, never some crappy page. If I can make it better another way, I judge it by eye.
